title: Partner Portal 1.1.0
summary: Support page with tickets, conversation with attachments and e-mail notifications.

items.title: Support page
items.body: Open and follow tickets from the portal: totals, a six-month chart, the ticket table and the conversation of each ticket.

items.title: Screenshots and files in the conversation
items.body: Paste a screenshot or attach a file (images, PDF, logs, zip) to a ticket.

items.title: E-mail when there is an answer
items.body: The person who opened the ticket receives an e-mail when support answers, with the ticket reference.

items.title: Tickets from the Cloud Controller
items.body: Tickets opened from a customer controller appear in the same list, together with the results of the Support Packets sent from the firewall.

items.title: Attachment upload
items.body: Uploading an image or file to a ticket failed with a 400 error in some browsers. It now works.
